published_parameter_role: Table 1 rounded central values, not a new fit or an exact historical optimizer state
overall_sign: simultaneously flipping Nh_u, Nh_d, Nc_u and Nc_d leaves leptonic products invariant before sign-sensitive external constraints; paper chooses positive u; no automatic canonicalization in a lattice-constrained fit

domains.a_b: closed nonnegative for point values; normalization derivatives at zero are singular and rejected, except the identically zero x=1 endpoint
domains.alpha_beta: closed nonnegative reconstruction domain; original MINUIT bounds were not recovered
domains.Nc: finite dimensionful amplitudes in GeV; no automatic unit-interval or positivity bound
domains.gc: finite with gc<gh for the supplied fixed CSS gh (default 0.042 GeV2)
domains.decoder: direct physical coordinates; no exp/tanh-only mapping of closed boundaries

transversity.normalization: evaluate in logs with continuous t*ln(t)=0 at t=0; x=1 returns zero with zero parameter derivatives
transversity.Soffer: fixed nonnegative (f1+g1)/2, reject negative input without clipping
transversity.flavors: u,d active; all antiquark, strange and heavy transversities zero in this historical family

Collins.quantity: dimensionful KPSY Hhat3, not Trento first moment
Collins.light_unfavored: remaining u,d,ubar,dbar flavors use the same unfavored basis, not a separate antiquark DSS FF
Collins.strange: Nc_d*z^alpha_d*(1-z)^beta_d times the separate D_pi+/s or D_pi+/sbar basis for either pion charge
Collins.pi_zero: explicit isospin reconstruction extension: average of plus and minus
Collins.heavy: zero heavy Collins is an explicit reconstruction assumption; no author-code recovery or experimental heavy-flavor admission is claimed
Collins.endpoint: D(1)=0; return zero before logs/powers, including beta=0 and all parameter derivatives
Collins.Trento: H1perp(1)=-Hhat3/(2*z*M_h), with explicit positive caller-supplied mass

evolution.interface: fixed-grid generic Julia matrix application to the initial flavor matrices
evolution.operators: distinct transversity and explicitly tagged KPSY_Hhat3_homogeneous operators; same fixed-nf LO kernel under COLLINEAR-LO-002
evolution.settings: Q02=2.4, asymptotic_two_loop, nf=5, Lambda=0.225; no fitted setting derivatives
evolution.resources: dense operator reference only; no claim of a scalable many-b fitting backend

input_support: strict initial-scale CT10/DSSV08/DSS14; x>=1e-5, z>=0.05, grids end at one; no extrapolated full tensor charge

validation_policy.physical_grid_alignment: log/sqrt background augmented with all locked CT10/DSSV/DSS knots in strict support and the declared probes; preserve distinct source literal values; background-only pilot failed unchanged targets

limitations: No historical fit or production extraction; printed Table 1 values are rounded
Heavy Collins and neutral-pion extension are declared reconstruction assumptions
Dense operator applications do not establish many-scale performance or production derivative admission
Source-range sensitivity, experimental target/axis/acceptance/overlap/covariance and uncertainty coverage remain open
